Python Integration Developer

Example Diagnostics AB

We build internal tools for diagnostic workflows and laboratory operations.

Who are we looking for?

You are an engineer who can connect Python, integration work, validation, traceability, and clear technical communication.

  • Experience with REST APIs, XML or JSON flows, and Linux services.
  • Interest in healthcare, laboratory systems, LIMS, or applied AI tools.

What we offer

Hybrid work, trust, and meaningful product ownership.
